name: Siela A. Bynoe
bottom_line: Her career history checks out against county, Senate and press records. But the page is out of date: it says she is in her fifth term in the County Legislature, when she has been a State Senator since January 2025. Dollar figures for her housing work are unsourced.
findings: Housing authority roles, school board service and the 2014 special election are all confirmed.
The "now in her fifth term" line describes a seat she left; it never mentions she is the incumbent senator.
page_issues: Reads as a 2024 page that was never updated for her Senate term.
